title: Partition Venus1 shuffle domains at the RTL MaxAVL boundary
objective: Prevent Gem5-only success from hiding deterministic Venus1 RTL index wrap when vshuffle addresses element 16384 or above.

rules.statement: For every vshuffle gather or scatter, prove that every runtime index is in [0, MaxAVL). Resolve MaxAVL from the selected backend's authoritative RTL or a reviewed backend manifest field; extended-vector capacity and task workspace size do not enlarge the shuffle index domain.
rules.falsification: A different reviewed RTL/backend digest may define a different MaxAVL and therefore a different legal interval.

rules.statement: When a logical tensor or destination placement crosses MaxAVL, partition it into independently returned or consumed chunks and rebase every per-chunk shuffle index below MaxAVL. Audit task-call arguments, output ports, 64-byte transfer alignment and Scheduler L2 pressure after partitioning.
rules.falsification: A non-shuffle implementation or an RTL-proven wider index path may avoid partitioning, but requires equivalent exact Gem5 and fresh-RTL evidence.

rules.statement: Gem5 correctness is insufficient when a candidate uses shuffle indices at or above the selected MaxAVL. Qualification requires fresh RTL output comparison, and a future shared-model change should include focused 16383/16384 positive-negative regressions.
rules.falsification: The extra RTL boundary gate is unnecessary when static proof establishes that all possible indices are below MaxAVL.

backend_scoped_evidence.workload: Damoda Hive HIVE_PHY_TX_OFDM CP/WOLA chunk assembly

rejected_candidate.qpsk_result: 39/45 visible outputs exact; task 5 port 0 indices 16384..17567 wrapped onto 0..1183
rejected_candidate.16qam_result: 21/24 visible outputs exact; the same task 5 prefix plus half0 and scaled-half0 failed
rejected_candidate.localization: RTL task-5 head[0:1184] equaled the correct Gem5 tail[16384:17568], while the RTL tail was zero

selected_candidate.fresh_rtl_result: QPSK 47/47 and 16QAM 25/25 visible outputs exact; both embedded final-output oracles passed
selected_candidate.l2_result: QPSK ended at 0x7b3c0 with 52288-byte margin; 16QAM ended at 0x45500 with 273152-byte margin

non_transferable_items: the Damoda tensor sizes and split point
promotion_conditions: A reduced 16383/16384 gather-and-scatter boundary probe on this exact Venus1 RTL
A reviewed backend-manifest representation of MaxAVL or an equivalent static compiler gate
A separate Gem5 model/regression change that reproduces the RTL boundary without modifying historical evidence

shadow_patch.reason: This proposal records backend-scoped workload evidence. Shared skill, compiler and Gem5 changes require separate human review and focused regressions.

rollback: Remove this proposal and its proposed-index entry; the workload partition and immutable qualification evidence remain valid.
